description: Reviewed OSIS 2.1.1 structure gate, not a replacement for the official XSD.

semantics.metadata_header: OSIS work/revision metadata; preserve exactly and never treat as canonical Scripture
semantics.list: Preserve introduction and authorial list hierarchy and item boundaries
semantics.item: Preserve original list item text and sequence
semantics.table: Preserve source authorial table, including introduction tables
semantics.row: Preserve row order and semantics within tables
semantics.cell: Preserve table cell order, column/row attributes and contents

schema_review.verified_from: HTTPS official publisher, SHA-256 and import manifest inspected by GitHub Actions
schema_review.note: Approval covers the pinned schema bytes and single W3C XML dependency only. It does not approve any source module or normalizer rule.

note: Expanded element allowlist after validating actual eBible LSG's u2o-generated output against official pinned CrossWire XSD. Structure is accepted only for inspection; publication still requires full fidelity review.
